First, on the release path: The AGPL compliance option is effectively blocked by the customer contract prohibition on delivering proprietary source code that Thomas identified. The replacement path is the only viable option. I'm committing to the replacement path effective immediately.

Maya, please confirm with engineering that the 10-business-day replacement timeline starts today and that they can commit to that schedule.

I will withhold final legal approval until: (1) the replacement build and regression testing are complete, (2) Samir confirms the internal alternative has no new open-source license issues, and (3) Thomas confirms any required customer notices have been sent. But we are formally on the replacement path as of now.
